### Pray for Jerusalem!
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-june-17-2010-11633350.html
Passage: Psalm 122:6
Points:
- World history and biblical prophecy are intrinsically linked to Israel and Jerusalem.
- Followers of Christ share a spiritual heritage received through the Jewish people and the Scriptures.
- Believers are commanded by God to bless Israel and seek the peace of Jerusalem.
- Praying for Jerusalem looks forward to Christ's promised return to the Mount of Olives.

### The Joy of Going to the Lord’s House
Author: Robert VanDoodewaard
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-joy-of-going-to-the-lords-house
Passage: Psalm 122:3–8
Points:
- Losing the privilege of corporate worship awakens Christians to appreciate gathering together.
- David rejoiced in the unity and communal thanksgiving of Israel after seasons of strife.
- Genuine believers are marked by a deep desire to seek peace and build up God's house.
- Believers anchor their hope in Jesus Christ, who serves as their ultimate source of peace.
